WaMatrix is a multi-tenant, white-label CRM for WhatsApp built on the Meta Cloud API. A business can run its own WhatsApp marketing, automation, and support — or an agency can resell the whole platform to its clients under its own brand. Flat pricing, no per-seat fees, and a free-forever plan to start.

The WhatsApp Business API is one of the highest-converting channels a business can use — and one of the most confusing to buy. Per-seat fees, per-message credits, opaque markups on Meta's own charges, and "reseller" programs that turn out to be affiliate links.

We built WaMatrix to fix that: a serious WhatsApp platform with pricing you can understand without a spreadsheet, and a genuine white-label model that lets agencies build a real business on top of it. You pay Meta directly, we add 0% markup, and what an agency charges its clients above the flat platform fee is entirely their margin.
Built for agencies, not just businesses
Multi-tenant, white-label SaaS. Agencies launch their own branded messaging platform — not an affiliate link, a real product they own.

How is WhatsApp marketing different from SMS or email?

WhatsApp opens at ~98% within minutes; email at ~18% within hours; SMS at ~75% but is one-way and lacks rich media. WhatsApp supports two-way conversations, buttons, images, PDF attachments, and structured templates. The cost-per-impression on WhatsApp is higher than SMS on a unit basis, but the conversion uplift more than compensates for most marketing budgets.
